title: a16z Podcast: Old Food, New Tech -- 'Clean Meat'

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: You’ve heard the numbers or some statistic like this: By the year 2050.
reader_summary.overview: You’ve heard the numbers or some statistic like this: By the year 2050, we’ll need to feed 9.7 billion humans on the planet. Our current production and meat-making methods -- growing crops to feed to animals to turn them into food -- can’t keep up … not to mention it’s not very good for the environment.. Yet meat is at the center of the plate for most meals, for most people.

key_points.text: Our current production and meat-making methods -- growing crops to feed to animals to turn them into food -- can’t keep up … not to mention it’s not very good for the environment..
So how do we go from where we are to where we need to be?
Especially since food is fundamentally an emotional experience!
